# Goose editor data

Editor-only assets from aardappel/goose v2026.4, pinned in manifest.json. Apache License 2.0; original license retained. The grammar and language configuration are copied without semantic changes. The monochrome icon retains the original paths and is centered in an Android vector viewport; foreground color follows the workbench theme. Compiler/runtime sources and binaries are not bundled. Goose toolchain installation and updates remain user-requested.
